key.name: rediscover-trigger
key.description: Bumped by the preferences window to ask the running extension to restart network discovery. The value carries no meaning; only the change notification matters (the shell and preferences run in separate processes, so this acts as a one-way signal).

key.name: discovered-lights
key.description: Lights the running extension has discovered, each as an "address|port|model" string (pipe-separated because IPv6 addresses contain colons). Published by the shell so the preferences window (a separate process that does not browse the network itself) can offer to rename or identify them.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that turns every known light on or off.
